## POLICY_LAYERS variable

Which policy layer a decision came from.

- `'host'` — the machine-wide governance policy. - `'key'` — the narrower policy attached to the authenticated API key.

**Signature:**

```typescript
POLICY_LAYERS: readonly[('host', 'key')]
```
